title: OKR Strata: Operationalizing Company OKRs via Initiative Slices
creator: Lena Park
description:
Problem statement: leadership wants a repeatable, low-friction way to translate company-level OKRs into prioritized, decoupled initiatives that can be executed by cross-functional squads without constant arbitration. Current gaps: ambiguous decision rights across PM/Eng/Design, initiatives that bundle unrelated work (risking cross-team blocking), and a lack of clear guardrails for slicing initiatives into deliverable increments that map to KRs.

Goal: produce an operational playbook and an Initiative Slice Matrix (CSV + Confluence template) that programmatically maps each company OKR to 3 layers: Strategy (objective + alias), Initiative (outcome slice), and Deliverable (release/epic). The playbook will codify decision owners, release gates, measurement signals, and escalation paths.

Scope: company-level OKRs only (not team tactical OKRs). Deliverables: 1) Initiative Slice Matrix template (CSV + Confluence page), 2) RACI for decision rights at each slice layer, 3) a pre-flight checklist for release gating (quality/regression/observability), 4) a short rollout plan for Q2 planning and a pilot with 3 initiative leads.

Key trade-offs considered: 1) Strict centralization (one owner per objective) simplifies alignment but risks slow local decision-making; we propose a hybrid: central Objective Steward + distributed Initiative Leads. 2) Deeply decomposing initiatives reduces cross-team coupling but increases integration overhead; we will prioritize early contracts/interfaces (APIs/SLAs) as part of the slice template. 3) Conservative rollout (only two teams in pilot) vs. fast wide rollout; choose conservative pilot to iterate on slice template and RACI before Q2 planning.

Outputs and formats: all artifacts will live under Confluence + a CSV export for import into Linear and our roadmap tool. Example artifact links included below.
acceptance_criteria: Confluence playbook live with 'Initiative Slice Matrix' template and example filled for 3 company OKRs
RACI matrix published and signed off by VP Product, Head of Engineering, and Head of Design
Pilot completed with 3 initiative leads and retrospective notes captured; 2 adjustments made to the slice template
Mapping process integrated into Q2 planning checklist and a Linear import CSV prepared
SLO/observability gates and measurement signals defined for at least the high-impact initiatives
next_steps: Mar 20: run stakeholder workshop (VP Product, Eng leads, Design leads, Growth) to socialise the playbook draft
Mar 24: ship first Confluence draft + CSV template and circulate for feedback
Mar 28: select 3 pilot initiatives and assign Initiative Leads
Apr 03: run pilot kickoff and capture slice decomposition in the matrix
Apr 14: retro pilot and finalize playbook for Q2 planning
risks: Ambiguous decision ownership leading to scope churn
Over-slicing causes lost end-to-end ownership and delayed integrations
Insufficient measurement signals for KRs (quality vs. usage ambiguity)
Dependence on ENG-18765 (console rollout infra) could delay release gates
